notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
Added 2 scenes and 10 achievements.
More content will be added soon.

notes.title: Have you wanted to go to an island lost in the ocean for a long time?
notes.content:
Have you wanted to go to an island lost in the ocean for a long time? Then pack your bags, because Mysterious Island - a Hidden Object Adventure is already in early access!

The first five levels are available for brave travelers, and there will be more of them in the very near future!
In addition, with the next update, a new game mode will be added - for a while!
